fields.description: The Bench Instance name the refused call was trying to start. Data rather than a Link, same reason as Bench Admission.bench: the instance row may not exist yet.

fields.description: Which guard inside admission.claim() refused the call.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: When the refusal happened, inside the same locked transaction that decided it.

fields.description: The plan's instance cap at the moment of refusal. Blank for a Shortfall reason — the cap guard never ran.
fields.label: Limit At Decision

fields.description: The account's active_instances count the Cap guard compared against the limit. Blank for a Shortfall or Suspended reason.
fields.label: Active Instances At Decision

fields.description: The credit hold this claim was asking to take. Blank or zero for a Cap or Suspended reason — the Shortfall guard is the only one that compares a cost.
fields.label: Requested Cost

fields.description: What account.spendable() returned for the Shortfall guard's comparison. Blank for a Cap or Suspended reason.
fields.label: Available At Decision
